summary: Fresh independent Luna review of PR #1293 head d11e3694 remains NO-GO: unit contents are not pinned, privileged ancestors below the snapshot root need root ownership, and pathname reopens leave TOCTOU gaps after metadata validation.
validation: Exact head d11e3694a4f651eb62e2076fc4da30b2ebf075ba reviewed against base efb9faac0606e02b7cac8e36e716f1ede9a50fb6.
Reviewer locally proved a user-owned 0700 root/etc ancestor can contain otherwise root-owned privileged files and still pass.
Exact-head Validate passed in 7m06s; guard and ARC classifier pass; protected ARC producer remains queued and is not merge evidence.
blockers: Pin and verify reviewed systemd unit contents by digest or strict directive allowlist; add a unit-content tamper test.
Require root ownership for every privileged-path ancestor below snapshot root, with only a narrowly explicit workspace exception; add ownership mutation coverage.
Replace lstat-then-pathname-read sequences with descriptor-anchored no-follow opens, fstat, and descriptor reads/parsing; add a real swap-race test.
next_action: Return to Luna code owner for loop-3 remediation of unit integrity, ancestor ownership, and descriptor-anchored race safety, then independently re-review the new exact head.

issues.title: Runner systemd unit contents are not verified
issues.details: A root-owned correctly named unit with arbitrary ExecStart passes because only path, ownership, mode, and synthetic service state are checked.

issues.title: Privileged ancestors below snapshot root need root ownership
issues.details: A user-owned non-writable-to-group-or-other ancestor can contain root-owned privileged artifacts and still pass the trust-chain validation.

issues.title: Metadata-to-content checks retain pathname TOCTOU windows
issues.details: Artifacts, sudo policy, and service checks validate metadata then reopen by pathname, permitting concurrent object replacement or symlink substitution.
